value_blindness: committed before any KLF12 value of any candidate reference was read; no value-derived artifact exists
reason: stand-in review (report 20260925T214313Z-b97586d5c42b, B2, PROVEN): amendment 11's guard (ece9cdb) changed amendment 07/08's frozen merge-deletion rule for _only_commit, while amendment 11 stated that every rule of amendments 01-10 stood. Owner decision 2026-09-25: restore amendment 07's rule; do not ratify amendment 11's change
kind_of_change: RESTORATION of a previously frozen acceptance criterion; no new criterion is adopted

withdrawn.what: the unintended _only_commit semantic change (changes.writes_absence_is_a_state as applied to frozen files, and changes.effect_on_only_commit): under amendment 11 a merge dropping a frozen file present in only one parent was not a write. That change is withdrawn, not ratified

restored.rule: amendment 07's merge rule, as frozen in amendment 07 (guard_merge_writes) and repeated in amendment 08: for _only_commit a merge counts as writing a frozen file if its tree entry (mode and blob) differs from every parent's, OR the merge drops the file. _writes applies this by default with logic identical to the guard pinned by amendment 10

between_check.rule: the between-amendments check alone (amendment 10's merge-aware check) calls _writes with inherited_absence=True: a merge that lacks a docs/phase2b/ file exactly as one of its parents lacks it carries that parent's deletion and is not a new write; a merge that adds a file neither parent holds, or deletes a file every parent holds, or holds novel bytes or a changed mode, is a write between stages
between_check.why: this is the correction of the false refusal amendment 11 reported against amendment 10's claim, now confined to the between check

corrects.statement: 'a later commit restored it, which is itself a write' (11.md) and 'a later commit restored it, which is itself a write (tested: refused)' (11.json effect_on_only_commit) are too broad
corrects.precise: a NON-MERGE commit that restores a frozen file is a write. A MERGE that restores it by taking one parent's exact entry is not counted as a write (amendment 07's rule): those bytes are that parent's, and whichever commit first wrote them is itself listed. So no bytes can enter the frozen file without a counted write, but not every restoration is itself a counted write

tests: _only_commit counts a merge deletion of a frozen file, even when the other parent never held it
between amendments: an absence inherited from one parent is not a new write (passes)
between amendments: a merge introducing a new docs/phase2b/ file refuses
between amendments: a merge deleting a docs/phase2b/ file every parent holds refuses (with a positive control without the deletion)
novel bytes and mode-only changes in a merge are writes under both rules
under amendment 11's rule the restored-rule tests fail
unchanged: the scientific method and the C4 protocol: candidate selection, donors, population, comparability route and stack identification, quantity, derivation, S1-S5, thresholds, variants and verdict rules; the amendment-05 frozen citation and the owner's B1/B2 resolution; amendments 07-11 are not edited
implementation_pin_authority: this amendment (12) supersedes amendment 11 as the implementation-pin authority

frozen_threshold_derivation_citation.rule: at C5 the definition file's threshold_derivation is exactly this string, byte for byte; any other value is a deviation. It must pass Phase 2A RR14's repository-citation check (_repository_citation) against the frozen definition pre-registration

candidate_selection.rule: qualification.select(inventory, min_reference_donors=3): metadata-only D1/D2/D5/D8 qualification, then the D7 order
candidate_selection.fallthrough: a VALUE-BLIND failure of the selected candidate (retrieval checksum, pipeline reproduction, reprocessing, donor-label join, fewer than min_reference_donors donors with cells) passes to the next candidate in the frozen order; a VALUE-AWARE failure (derive() returns NO_STABLE_SEPARATION) never does, because trying candidates until one separates would select a reference by its KLF12 distribution
candidate_selection.next_candidates: none: C03 is the only metadata-qualified candidate

rr14_citations.evidence_citation: E-MTAB-10283 (the reference dataset the state separation is measured in), evidence_kind reference_state_separation
rr14_citations.comparability_evidence: doi:10.5281/zenodo.17412607 (the ADOC pipeline code and lock file) together with the committed stack-identification result

verdict_rules: NO_SUITABLE_REFERENCE: no candidate qualifies on metadata; or every qualified candidate fails a value-blind check that is not a comparability failure; or derive() returns NO_STABLE_SEPARATION
BLOCKED_COMPARABILITY: no Cell Ranger stack passes the stack-identification test, or the pinned stack cannot process the selected candidate and no later candidate exists
BLOCKED_OWNER_DECISION: derive() qualifies but a requirement needs an owner decision not yet taken (owner acceptance under RR12, or activation of config/personalization.yaml)

QUALIFIED_REFERENCE_FOUND: derive() qualifies and phase2a_contract.evaluate_reference, run on the committed reference files with the manifest named in memory, reports no RR01-RR12 or RR14 failure other than the RR10 activation clause that only the owner's activation commit can satisfy; it enables assumption_conditioned_scenario mapping only, RR13 stays unmet, and no donor-specific model is produced
